title: Use i;unicode-casemap for FileNode case-insensitive names
description: #11 (fd99a85), draft line 73: names compare with i;unicode-casemap (RFC 5051). backend.rs:21-40,684-716 says 'implementation-defined'; memory.rs:1352,1369,1394 uses to_lowercase. Move casemap_prepare from crate-jmap-metadata-server filter.rs:197 into a shared crate and use it for CaseFolding::Insensitive.
notes: 2026-11-13 spec-sync batch 1: filenode-20 group NOT integrated (verify failed at b9e88191, branch worktree-wf_d9b28b7b-50b-9 kept unmerged). Work in a69c0f36. Remaining (blocking): MemoryBackend glob_match_case_insensitive (nameMatch) still folds with char::to_lowercase; apply unicode_casemap_prepare to pattern and name (-20 §1.1) and add a test (fullwidth / dotless-i).
